sentences.en: When the cold winter began, the old man's health deteriorated.
sentences.zh: 冬天来临后，老人的身体状况开始变差。

sentences.en: Liz's son's behaviour started to deteriorate when he started secondary school.
sentences.zh: 莉兹的儿子自从上了中学以后行为就开始变差。

sentences.en: Relations between Algeria and Morocco have been deteriorating for some time.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚和摩洛哥两国的关系已经持续恶化一段时间了。
